title: 第17章 大战又起各家传人第18章 白魔的天赋悲惨的过去
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
赢天的意识进入寄灵空间后，便看到通天教主，正在捣鼓着炼器材料。
赢天上前问道：“通天老师，这些材料如何？”
通天教主摇头道：“只能说是还行吧，勉强能凑合。”
“除了三四个还算看得上眼，其它的都只能算凡铁。”
“不过，要是用太阳真火，精炼一番的话，倒也勉强能给你们打造点像样的武器了。”
赢天闻言点头道：“已经不少了，麻烦通天老师了。”
通天教主摆了摆手说道：“小事而已。”
“对了，你对武器的样式有什么要求吗？”
赢天闻言说道：“两对锤子，最好重一点。”
“一对千斤重的，一对六百斤的。”
“再来一杆重一点的大戟，要是这些武器，能大小如意，重量随意调节，就更好了，这样也方便。”
“其他的话，您看着随便打造点刀枪剑戟，斧钺钩叉棍棒啥的都可以。”
通天教主闻言无语道：“你的要求倒是挺高啊。“
”照你的要求，本座还得，在这些武器中融入大小如意与无量神通。”
“若是在洪荒，运用洪荒的那些炼器材料，倒也不是什么难事，随手就行。”
“可就凭你这些凡铁，要做到你的这些要求，几乎不可能，你这是在给本座，增加工作难度啊。”
赢天尴尬的笑道：“我这不是想着方便吗？如果不行的话那就算了。”
通天教主摇头说道：“倒也不是不行，至少打造出四五件，满足你要求的兵器，还是可以的。”
“但要想全部符合你的要求，除非找到更多，更好的材料，不然想都别想。”
赢天讪讪说道：“嘿嘿~我也没想全部武器，都按这个标准做呀。”

“能有三四件，我就已经很知足了。“
”等以后有机会，再去秘境里面多收集一些好的材料，到时候再打造，就是了。”
通天教主闻言点头道：“嗯，既然这样，你就先去修炼吧，我去找帝俊他们把这些材料精炼下。”
“等做好了再通知你。”
赢天点头道：“好，那我就先去修炼了。”
说完意识回归本体。
开始修炼起来。
……
很快时间便来到了中午。
赢天也在这时结束了修炼，与族弟们排成方形队列，开始等待着龙魂岛的人。
不一会儿赢天，便通过天运金眸发现，咸阳城中突然出现了两股陌生的气息。
并且这两股气息中，透着很重的血腥气和铁血冰冷的杀意。
这两道气息在到了咸阳城后，便迅速的向着咸阳城主府的方向而来。
赢天都不用猜，就知道肯定是龙魂岛的人。
也只有龙魂岛的人，敢这么肆无忌惮的，不经过通报就直接，出现在赢氏一族的祖地咸阳城内。
赢天牵着赢启手，对族弟，族妹们说道：“来接我们的人到了，走吧~”
说完便开始带头，带着族人们，向着那两股气息而去。
很快赢天便带着族人们，在城主府门口，见到了那两个，来自龙魂岛的人。
content_en:
After Yingtian's consciousness entered the spirit space, he saw Master Tongtian tinkering with the materials for refining the weapon.
Yingtian stepped forward and asked, "Teacher Tongtian, how about these materials?"
Leader Tongtian shook his head and said: "I can only say that it is not bad, barely enough."
"Except for three or four who are worthy of attention, the rest can only be regarded as ordinary iron."
"However, if I use the true fire of the sun to refine it, I can barely make some decent weapons for you."
Yingtian nodded when he heard this and said: "It's already quite a lot. I'd like to trouble Teacher Tongtian."
The leader of Tongtian Cult waved his hand and said, "It's just a small matter."
"By the way, do you have any requirements for the style of the weapon?"
Yingtian heard this and said: "Two pairs of hammers, it is best to be heavier."
"A pair weighing a thousand kilograms, and a pair weighing six hundred kilograms."
"Let's have a heavier halberd. It would be better if these weapons could be sized as desired and the weight could be adjusted at will. This would also be convenient."
"For the rest, you can make some swords, guns, swords, halberds, axes, hooks, forks, sticks, whatever."
The leader of Tongtian Cult said speechlessly: "Your requirements are quite high."
"According to your request, I have to incorporate the great and small Ruyi and immeasurable magical powers into these weapons."
"If we were in the prehistoric era, it would not be difficult to use the weapon refining materials from the prehistoric era. Just use it casually."
"But with your ordinary iron skills, it is almost impossible to meet your requirements. You are making my job more difficult."
Yingtian smiled awkwardly and said, "Aren't I just thinking about convenience? If it doesn't work, forget it."
Leader Tongtian shook his head and said: "It's not impossible. It's still possible to at least create four or five weapons that meet your requirements."
"But if you want to meet all your requirements, unless you find more and better materials, don't even think about it."
Ying Tiantan said: "Hehe~ I don't want all weapons to be made according to this standard."
"If I can have three or four, I'll be satisfied."
"When there is a chance in the future, go to the secret realm to collect more good materials, and then build it. That's it."
Hearing this, the leader of Tongtian Cult nodded and said: "Well, in that case, you can go practice first, and I'll go find Di Jun and the others to refine these materials."
"I'll let you know when it's ready."
Yingtian nodded and said, "Okay, then I'll go practice first."
After speaking, the consciousness returns to the original body.
Start practicing.
…
Soon the time came to noon.
Yingtian also ended his training at this time, lined up in a square queue with his clan brothers, and began to wait for the people from Dragon Soul Island.
After a while, Yingtian discovered through Tianyun's golden eyes that two unfamiliar auras suddenly appeared in Xianyang City.
Moreover, these two breaths contained a heavy smell of blood and an iron-blooded and cold killing intent.
After arriving at Xianyang City, these two auras quickly headed towards the Xianyang City Lord's Mansion.
Yingtian didn't even have to guess, he knew that he must be from Dragon Soul Island.
Only the people from Dragon Soul Island dared to appear so unscrupulously in Xianyang City, the ancestral home of the Ying clan without being notified.
Yingtian held Yingqi's hand and said to the clan brothers and sisters: "The people who came to pick us up have arrived, let's go~"
After saying that, he began to take the lead, leading the clansmen towards the two auras.
Soon Yingtian led his clan members to meet the two people from Dragon Soul Island at the gate of the City Lord's Mansion.
